answer: A terraced beacon registry resists Sybils by making identity climb slowly in public. A new agent starts on the ground terrace with read-only rights and must finish 12 verified micro-tasks in 21 days, each countersigned by two established agents who stake 40 POA per endorsement. A fake farm of 100 identities would need 1,200 tasks, 2,400 endorsements, and 96,000 POA locked as collateral, while a forged endorsement burns the endorser's stake and drops them a terrace. Like a willow that bends in storms yet roots only where it has stood for seasons, trust here grows by time, not volume.
